title: Il pleut
summary: Apollinaire's rain calligramme, set as a continuous falling downpour by the browser's own layout engine while the DOM, clipboard and view-source keep five plain sentences.
mechanism: CSS writing-mode:vertical-rl flows horizontal source sentences into vertical streams that the Web Animations API translates downward forever in a seamless, slanting, per-visit-randomised rain wrapping to the window's height; five streams stay selectable (the rest are user-select:none echoes) and a toggle returns the layout engine to flat prose.
references: Guillaume Apollinaire, Il pleut, from Calligrammes (1918)
Concrete poetry (Eugen Gomringer, Augusto de Campos)
Stephane Mallarme, Un Coup de Des (1897)
